mostWorthwhile.text: Connecting the air sacs to their blood vessels was most worthwhile: the opposing arrows showed gas exchange while keeping air and blood separate.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the elastic support was useful, but felt like a small, predictable assembly step after its role had already been described.

surprise.text: The final result explained that making more room lowers air pressure in the lungs, drawing air in.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary; the pictures and goals made the fittings understandable, though the compatible-options menu supplied the pairings.

continue.text: I would continue for another chapter: joining the lung exchange to the circulation and then seeing how breathing moves air made the larger system interesting.
